summary: Split large requirements files with an include entry pointing to another YAML file, then install by passing the root file.
questions: How do I split a big requirements.yml into several files?

answer_card.title: Include other requirements files
answer_card.answer_md:
In `requirements.yml`:
```yaml
- name: yatesr.timezone
- include: <path_to_requirements>/webserver.yml
```
Then install from the root file:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role install -r requirements.yml
```
